name: thinking-arcade
description: Session-gated Space Invaders sidecar game (Model Invaders) that plays while your coding agents are thinking or running tools, pauses when any conversation needs you, and lists those conversations with one-click links back. Works with Google Antigravity, Claude Code, and OpenAI Codex CLI.
suggestedPrompts: Show my Thinking Arcade status and which conversations need me
Switch Model Invaders to the Right Auxiliary Pane
Configure Thinking Arcade hooks for Claude Code and OpenAI Codex CLI
